'''Magister Protector''' was a rank used in [[the Crucible]], a slaver organization active prior to and during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Holders of this rank concerned themselves in dealing with threats to the organization. At the time of [[3963 BBY]], [[Bar'injar]] held the rank, which was reflected in his name.
